Once you provide one of those options I’ll verify and then look up your Platinum Rewards Card to see whether you qualify for an annual-fee rebate. If you’d prefer not to share details here, I can transfer you to a human agent. Which would you like to do?

Sure — I can do the two-details option.

- Date of birth: 05/12/1991  
- Address: 3421 Sakura Avenue, Portland, OR 97205

- Rho-Bank user ID (best), or  
- Your full name exactly as on file, or

If you prefer not to provide that here, I can transfer you to a human agent—would you like that instead?
